+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { queryKey } from '@tanstack/query-test-utils'
+import {
+  QueryCache,
+  QueryClient,
+  QueryObserver,
+  createPersisterRestoreResult,
+  reconcileQueryState,
+} from '..'
+import type { QueryState } from '..'
+
+describe('createPersisterRestoreResult', () => {
+  let queryClient: QueryClient
+  let queryCache: QueryCache
+
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    queryCache = new QueryCache()
+    queryClient = new QueryClient({ queryCache })
+  })
+
+  test('should accept { data, state } and create a restore result', () => {
+    const state: Partial<QueryState> = {
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      error: new Error('persisted error'),
+      errorUpdatedAt: 1500,
+      fetchFailureCount: 3,
+      status: 'error',
+    }
+    const result = createPersisterRestoreResult({
+      data: 'persisted data',
+      state,
+    })
+
+    expect(result.data).toBe('persisted data')
+    expect(result.state).toBe(state)
+  })
+
+  test('prefetchQuery should adopt restored state without triggering fetch success callbacks', async () => {
+    const onSuccess = vi.fn()
+    const onSettled = vi.fn()
+    const customCache = new QueryCache({ onSuccess, onSettled })
+    const customClient = new QueryClient({ queryCache: customCache })
+
+    const key = queryKey()
+    const persistedError = new Error('persisted error')
+    const persistedState: Partial<QueryState> = {
+      data: 'cached data',
+      dataUpdatedAt: 100,
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      error: persistedError,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 150,
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      fetchFailureCount: 2,
+      fetchFailureReason: persistedError,
+      isInvalidated: true,
+      status: 'error',
+    }
+
+    await customClient.prefetchQuery({
+      queryKey: key,
+      queryFn: () => 'fresh server data',
+      persister: () =>
+        createPersisterRestoreResult({
+          data: 'cached data',
+          state: persistedState,
+        }),
+    })
+
+    expect(onSuccess).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(onSettled).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+
+    const query = customCache.find({ queryKey: key })!
+    expect(query).toBeDefined()
+    expect(query.state.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+    expect(query.state.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(query.state.data).toBe('cached data')
+    expect(query.state.error).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(query.state.fetchFailureCount).toBe(2)
+    expect(query.state.fetchFailureReason).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(query.state.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(100)
+    expect(query.state.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(150)
+    expect(query.state.isInvalidated).toBe(true)
+
+    const observer = new QueryObserver(customClient, { queryKey: key })
+    const result = observer.getCurrentResult()
+    expect(result.isRefetchError).toBe(true)
+    expect(result.data).toBe('cached data')
+    expect(result.error).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(result.failureCount).toBe(2)
+  })
+
+  test('infinite query should preserve pageParams and pagination state upon restoration', async () => {
+    const key = queryKey()
+    const paginationData = {
+      pages: ['page 1', 'page 2'],
+      pageParams: [undefined, 'cursor-2'],
+    }
+    const persistedError = new Error('page 3 failed')
+    const persistedState: Partial<QueryState> = {
+      data: paginationData,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 500,
+      error: persistedError,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 600,
+      fetchFailureCount: 1,
+      status: 'error',
+    }
+
+    await queryClient.prefetchInfiniteQuery({
+      queryKey: key,
+      queryFn: () => ({ pages: ['server'], pageParams: [undefined] }),
+      initialPageParam: 0,
+      getNextPageParam: () => null,
+      persister: () =>
+        createPersisterRestoreResult({
+          data: paginationData,
+          state: persistedState,
+        }),
+    })
+
+    const query = queryCache.find({ queryKey: key })!
+    expect(query.state.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+    expect(query.state.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(query.state.data).toEqual({
+      pages: ['page 1', 'page 2'],
+      pageParams: [undefined, 'cursor-2'],
+    })
+    expect(query.state.error).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(query.state.fetchFailureCount).toBe(1)
+  })
+
+  test('reconcileQueryState should independently merge newer live data and newer persisted error', () => {
+    const liveError = new Error('old live error')
+    const persistedError = new Error('newer persisted error')
+
+    const liveState: QueryState = {
+      data: 'newer live data',
+      dataUpdatedAt: 2000,
+      dataUpdateCount: 2,
+      error: liveError,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      fetchFailureCount: 1,
+      fetchFailureReason: liveError,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const persistedState: Partial<QueryState> = {
+      data: 'older persisted data',
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      error: persistedError,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 1500,
+      errorUpdateCount: 2,
+      fetchFailureCount: 4,
+      fetchFailureReason: persistedError,
+      isInvalidated: true,
+      status: 'error',
+    }
+
+    const reconciled = reconcileQueryState(liveState, persistedState)
+
+    // Data freshness: live is newer (2000 > 1000)
+    expect(reconciled.data).toBe('newer live data')
+    expect(reconciled.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(2000)
+
+    // Error freshness: persisted is newer (1500 > 1000)
+    expect(reconciled.error).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(reconciled.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(1500)
+    expect(reconciled.fetchFailureCount).toBe(4)
+    expect(reconciled.fetchFailureReason).toBe(persistedError)
+
+    // Status: both data and error are present -> error
+    expect(reconciled.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(reconciled.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+    expect(reconciled.isInvalidated).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  test('reconcileQueryState should independently merge newer persisted data and newer live error (inverse rule)', () => {
+    const liveError = new Error('newer live error')
+    const persistedError = new Error('older persisted error')
+
+    const liveState: QueryState = {
+      data: 'older live data',
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      error: liveError,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 2500,
+      errorUpdateCount: 2,
+      fetchFailureCount: 3,
+      fetchFailureReason: liveError,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const persistedState: Partial<QueryState> = {
+      data: 'newer persisted data',
+      dataUpdatedAt: 2000,
+      dataUpdateCount: 2,
+      error: persistedError,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 1500,
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      fetchFailureCount: 1,
+      fetchFailureReason: persistedError,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'error',
+    }
+
+    const reconciled = reconcileQueryState(liveState, persistedState)
+
+    // Data freshness: persisted is newer (2000 > 1000)
+    expect(reconciled.data).toBe('newer persisted data')
+    expect(reconciled.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(2000)
+
+    // Error freshness: live is newer (2500 > 1500)
+    expect(reconciled.error).toBe(liveError)
+    expect(reconciled.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(2500)
+    expect(reconciled.fetchFailureCount).toBe(3)
+    expect(reconciled.fetchFailureReason).toBe(liveError)
+
+    // Status: error, fetchStatus: idle
+    expect(reconciled.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(reconciled.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+  })
+})

diff --git a/packages/query-core/src/persisterRestoreResult.ts b/packages/query-core/src/persisterRestoreResult.ts
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..e9227f792
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/query-core/src/persisterRestoreResult.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,176 @@
+import type { QueryState } from './query'
+import type { DefaultError, QueryStatus } from './types'
+
+export const PERSISTER_RESTORE_RESULT_SYMBOL: unique symbol = Symbol.for(
+  '@tanstack/query-core/persisterRestoreResult',
+)
+
+export interface PersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+> {
+  readonly [PERSISTER_RESTORE_RESULT_SYMBOL]: true
+  readonly _isPersisterRestoreResult: true
+  readonly data: TData | undefined
+  readonly state: Partial<QueryState<TData, TError>> | undefined
+}
+
+export function isPersisterRestoreResult(
+  value: unknown,
+): value is PersisterRestoreResult<any, any> {
+  return (
+    typeof value === 'object' &&
+    value !== null &&
+    (PERSISTER_RESTORE_RESULT_SYMBOL in value ||
+      (value as any)._isPersisterRestoreResult === true)
+  )
+}
+
+export function createPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+>(result: {
+  data?: TData
+  state?: Partial<QueryState<TData, TError>>
+}): PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  const data = result.data !== undefined ? result.data : result.state?.data
+  return {
+    [PERSISTER_RESTORE_RESULT_SYMBOL]: true,
+    _isPersisterRestoreResult: true,
+    data,
+    state: result.state,
+  }
+}
+
+export function reconcileQueryState<TData = unknown, TError = DefaultError>(
+  liveState: QueryState<TData, TError>,
+  persistedState: Partial<QueryState<TData, TError>>,
+): QueryState<TData, TError> {
+  // 1. Data freshness
+  let resolvedData: TData | undefined
+  let resolvedDataUpdatedAt: number
+  let resolvedDataUpdateCount: number
+
+  const liveHasData = liveState.data !== undefined
+  const persistedHasData = persistedState.data !== undefined
+
+  const liveDataUpdatedAt = liveState.dataUpdatedAt
+  const persistedDataUpdatedAt = persistedState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0
+
+  if (persistedHasData && !liveHasData) {
+    resolvedData = persistedState.data
+    resolvedDataUpdatedAt = persistedDataUpdatedAt
+    resolvedDataUpdateCount = persistedState.dataUpdateCount ?? 0
+  } else if (liveHasData && !persistedHasData) {
+    resolvedData = liveState.data
+    resolvedDataUpdatedAt = liveDataUpdatedAt
+    resolvedDataUpdateCount = liveState.dataUpdateCount
+  } else if (persistedHasData && liveHasData) {
+    if (persistedDataUpdatedAt > liveDataUpdatedAt) {
+      resolvedData = persistedState.data
+      resolvedDataUpdatedAt = persistedDataUpdatedAt
+      resolvedDataUpdateCount =
+        persistedState.dataUpdateCount ?? liveState.dataUpdateCount
+    } else {
+      resolvedData = liveState.data
+      resolvedDataUpdatedAt = liveDataUpdatedAt
+      resolvedDataUpdateCount = liveState.dataUpdateCount
+    }
+  } else {
+    resolvedData = undefined
+    resolvedDataUpdatedAt = Math.max(liveDataUpdatedAt, persistedDataUpdatedAt)
+    resolvedDataUpdateCount = Math.max(
+      liveState.dataUpdateCount,
+      persistedState.dataUpdateCount ?? 0,
+    )
+  }
+
+  // 2. Error freshness
+  let resolvedError: TError | null
+  let resolvedErrorUpdatedAt: number
+  let resolvedErrorUpdateCount: number
+  let resolvedFetchFailureCount: number
+  let resolvedFetchFailureReason: TError | null
+
+  const liveHasError = liveState.error != null
+  const persistedHasError = persistedState.error != null
+
+  const liveErrorUpdatedAt = liveState.errorUpdatedAt
+  const persistedErrorUpdatedAt = persistedState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0
+
+  if (persistedHasError && !liveHasError) {
+    resolvedError = persistedState.error!
+    resolvedErrorUpdatedAt = persistedErrorUpdatedAt
+    resolvedErrorUpdateCount = persistedState.errorUpdateCount ?? 0
+    resolvedFetchFailureCount = persistedState.fetchFailureCount ?? 0
+    resolvedFetchFailureReason =
+      persistedState.fetchFailureReason ?? persistedState.error!
+  } else if (liveHasError && !persistedHasError) {
+    resolvedError = liveState.error
+    resolvedErrorUpdatedAt = liveErrorUpdatedAt
+    resolvedErrorUpdateCount = liveState.errorUpdateCount
+    resolvedFetchFailureCount = liveState.fetchFailureCount
+    resolvedFetchFailureReason = liveState.fetchFailureReason
+  } else if (persistedHasError && liveHasError) {
+    if (persistedErrorUpdatedAt > liveErrorUpdatedAt) {
+      resolvedError = persistedState.error!
+      resolvedErrorUpdatedAt = persistedErrorUpdatedAt
+      resolvedErrorUpdateCount =
+        persistedState.errorUpdateCount ?? liveState.errorUpdateCount
+      resolvedFetchFailureCount =
+        persistedState.fetchFailureCount ?? liveState.fetchFailureCount
+      resolvedFetchFailureReason =
+        persistedState.fetchFailureReason ?? persistedState.error!
+    } else {
+      resolvedError = liveState.error
+      resolvedErrorUpdatedAt = liveErrorUpdatedAt
+      resolvedErrorUpdateCount = liveState.errorUpdateCount
+      resolvedFetchFailureCount = liveState.fetchFailureCount
+      resolvedFetchFailureReason = liveState.fetchFailureReason
+    }
+  } else {
+    resolvedError = null
+    resolvedErrorUpdatedAt = Math.max(
+      liveErrorUpdatedAt,
+      persistedErrorUpdatedAt,
+    )
+    resolvedErrorUpdateCount = Math.max(
+      liveState.errorUpdateCount,
+      persistedState.errorUpdateCount ?? 0,
+    )
+    resolvedFetchFailureCount = Math.max(
+      liveState.fetchFailureCount,
+      persistedState.fetchFailureCount ?? 0,
+    )
+    resolvedFetchFailureReason = null
+  }
+
+  // 3. Status determination
+  let resolvedStatus: QueryStatus
+  if (resolvedError != null) {
+    resolvedStatus = 'error'
+  } else if (resolvedData !== undefined) {
+    resolvedStatus = 'success'
+  } else if (persistedState.status && persistedState.status !== 'error') {
+    resolvedStatus = persistedState.status
+  } else {
+    resolvedStatus = liveState.status
+  }
+
+  return {
+    data: resolvedData,
+    dataUpdatedAt: resolvedDataUpdatedAt,
+    dataUpdateCount: resolvedDataUpdateCount,
+    error: resolvedError,
+    errorUpdatedAt: resolvedErrorUpdatedAt,
+    errorUpdateCount: resolvedErrorUpdateCount,
+    fetchFailureCount: resolvedFetchFailureCount,
+    fetchFailureReason: resolvedFetchFailureReason,
+    fetchMeta: persistedState.fetchMeta ?? liveState.fetchMeta ?? null,
+    isInvalidated: Boolean(
+      liveState.isInvalidated || persistedState.isInvalidated,
+    ),
+    status: resolvedStatus,
+    fetchStatus: 'idle',
+  }
+}
